title: Canonical pushout presentations for active-root normalization
statement: Let $B,A$ be commutative rings with a specified $B$-algebra structure on $A$, let $r,s\geq0$, $t:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to B$, $\alpha:\operatorname{Fin}(s)\to\operatorname{Fin}(r)$, $p\in\mathbf N$, and $m>0$. Put $f=\prod_i t_i$, $C_m=B[x_i]/(x_i^m-t_i)$ and $T_m=A[z_j]/(z_j^m-t_{\alpha(j)})$ [def-sfb-parameter-root-algebra, def-sfb-simultaneous-root-tower]. Regard an $R$-algebra as an object under $R$. Its actual integral closure is the subalgebra of integral elements, with its subalgebra inclusion [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The diagonal algebra of degree $d\geq0$ is $R^{\operatorname{Fin}(d)}$ with the diagonal coefficient map, including the empty product. Define $S_m=A\otimes_B C_m$ and $S_m[1/f]=B[1/f]\otimes_B S_m$ by the chosen commutative-ring pushouts, with their coprojections [def-weil-ring-localization-away, def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. For a $B[1/f]$-algebra $D$, put $D_m=D\otimes_{B[1/f]}C_m[1/f]$ as a $C_m$-algebra and $E_m=\operatorname{IntCl}_{C_m}(D_m)$. Define the strict ambient algebra and strict closure to be the actual pushouts $D_m\otimes_{C_m}S_m$ and $E_m\otimes_{C_m}S_m$. Define $Q_m=T_m\otimes_B B[1/f]$, its $T_m$-coprojection, and the diagram of these algebras over positive orders coprime to $p$ with root power transitions. Define its colimit under $B[1/f]$ and scalar extension of $D$ by tensor pushout with its $D$-coprojection [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Define diagonal localization by applying $S_m\to S_m[1/f]$ in every coordinate. All constructions retain their specified structural maps.
